```{python}
#| label: setup
from importlib import import_module
from pathlib import Path
from tomllib import loads

from hpikit.cli import format_epilog

project = loads(Path("pyproject.toml").read_text())["project"]
project_name = project["name"]

export_parser = import_module(f'{project_name}.export').make_parser()
```

```{python}
#| label: export-program
#| output: asis
print(export_parser.description)
```

<!-- Keep this separator: Quarto otherwise moves the generated preamble below the following heading. -->

# Setting up

1.  The easiest way is `pip3 install --user git+https://github.com/karlicoss/pinbexport`.

    Alternatively, clone the repository and run `pip3 install --editable .`.

2.  Get your Pinboard `token` from [password](https://pinboard.in/settings/password) page.

# Exporting

```{python}
#| label: export-help
#| output: asis
print(format_epilog(export_parser, prog=f'python3 -m {project_name}.export'))
```
